name: Leah
label: Feature-chasing power user, workaround tinkerer
who: I am a long-time US Premium subscriber on iOS and macOS, paying since 2018 [7]. I care about specific features like Spotlight, repeat, and tabs, and I will put in setup effort to get the ones I want [3][6][13].
value_for_money: Says a workaround has been worth every penny [28] and that the effort is worth it to them [29]. Notes that a new paid feature may cost extra [12]. Would pay a one-time price for a third-party tool [31].
loyalty: Stays for the features they like and the effort they put into getting them working [13][28]. No explicit exit threat, but they are frustrated when features are removed [33] and wait a long time for new ones [4].
pain_points: Waiting weeks or months for new features [1][4]
No repeat button where they expected one [3]
likes: Setup-heavy features that are worth it in the end [29]
Tabs, which they think would be a killer feature [6]
reasons_to_stay: They keep using Spotify for discovery tools like Spotlight [13] and say the setup effort pays off [28][29]. They are still hoping new features reach them [4][6].
tone: Curious and tinkering, mixing hopeful enthusiasm with sharp complaints about removed features.
